channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Colts released Easton Stick.
item.description: Stick struggled in four starts, all losses, with the Chargers in 2023 and hasn’t seen a regular season snap since. He was behind Riley Leonard and Anthony Richardson on the Colts’ depth chart before being released.-Kyle Dvorchak

item.title: Chiefs released CB Kaiir Elam.
item.description: The former first-round pick is back on the market. Elam spent time on the Cowboys’ and Titans’ rosters last year after a three-year stint with the Bills. He has decent odds of landing with another team at age 25.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Ravens waived EDGE Adisa Isaac.
item.description: Isaac, who missed all of last season with an elbow injury, was late to return to practice this offsseaon. He played 32 defensive snaps in 2024. NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Isaac is “expected to draw interest” from teams.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Bears released Scotty Miller.
item.description: Miller signed with the Bears this offseason but failed to crack their 53-man roster as a depth option. With 93 career games under his belt and some experience on special teams, Miller should at least be able to land a practice squad gig in the coming days.-Kyle Dvorchak

item.title: Commanders released OG Max Scharping.
item.description: Scharping was signed earlier this month. He has not played much in recent years and tore and ACL in September 2025.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Buccaneers agreed to terms with RB Sean Tucker on a one-year, $2.5 million contract.
item.description: The contract comes fully guaranteed as Tucker gets the stability he was looking for this offseason after entering 2026 on a restricted free agent tender of $3.52 million. Tucker presumably sits third on the depth chart at running back for the Buccaneers after the addition of Kenny Gainwell, a situation he has grown accustomed to during his time in Tampa. The pay cut likely stands as a boost to starter Bucky Irving after numerous reports this offseason called for a potential three-way timeshare in the backfield, something that now appears less likely given current circumstances.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Buccaneers waived OLB Jack Pyburn.
item.description: The undrafted free agent rookie led the NFL with four preseason sacks this year. He is a candidate to land on a practice squad somewhere, if not in Tampa Bay.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Rams released DT Larrell Murchison.
item.description: The news was first reported by NFL Insider Aaron Wilson. Murchison was originally a fifth-round pick by the Titans in the 2020 NFL Draft. He appeared in 16 games with the Rams last year and had two sacks and three QB hits.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Commanders released OL Daniel Brunskill.
item.description: The seven-year veteran has amassed 71 starts across 108 appearances for the 49ers, Titans, and Dolphins and could quickly find his way onto an NFL roster as a viable depth piece capable of playing all five positions along the offensive line. He provides precisely the profile typically lauded by the Kyle Shanahan-Sean McVay coaching trees, which requires plus football IQ along with the ability to understand how multiple positions work together up front.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Bills waived WR Ja’Mori Maclin.
item.description: NBC Houston’s Aaron Wilson reports that Maclin could return to Buffalo as a member of the practice squad. Maclin, former NFL WR Jeremy Maclin’s cousin, was an interesting preseason follow.-Nic Bodiford
